facts.fact: Adwave says TV, Facebook, Instagram and web ads can run from a $30/day budget for locksmiths.
facts.quote: with Adwave they run from a $30/day budget.

facts.fact: On Adwave, TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram run from the $30/day minimum.
facts.quote: TV, Google (Search included), Facebook and Instagram run from the $30/day minimum.

facts.fact: On Adwave, Reddit runs from about $35 per day.
facts.quote: Reddit runs from about $35/day.

facts.fact: On Adwave, TikTok is opt-in from about $91 per day and requires connecting a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok is opt-in from about $91/day and needs you to connect a TikTok account.

facts.fact: Adwave's own pricing example is $75/day for 30 active days, a planning total of $2,250.
facts.quote: Adwave’s own pricing example is $75/day for 30 active days, a planning total of $2,250.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $6 per 15-second TV spot for extra creative beyond what is included.
facts.quote: Extra creative is billed separately, for example $6 per 15-second TV spot or $12 per 30-second spot.

facts.fact: Adwave's worked example: a single-van shop running $30/day for 30 active days spends $900.
facts.quote: A single-van shop running $30/day for 30 active days spends $900.

facts.fact: Adwave's worked example: a multi-truck shop at $91/day spends $2,730 over 30 days.
facts.quote: A multi-truck shop at $91/day spends $2,730 over 30 days

facts.fact: On Adwave, a campaign pauses if the prepaid wallet cannot cover the day's budget.
facts.quote: a campaign pauses if the wallet can’t cover the day.

facts.fact: Adwave states ACH deposits have no added fee, while card deposits add a processing fee shown at checkout.
facts.quote: Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout, and ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: Google states that ads cannot appear on related searches until a locksmith advertiser's verification is complete.
facts.quote: and ads cannot appear on related searches until verification is complete.

facts.fact: Google does not allow locksmith ads to run in Spain, the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden and Belgium.
facts.quote: Google does not allow locksmith ads to run at all in Spain, the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden and Belgium.

facts.fact: Google states advanced verification is separate from Google Business Profile verification, and a verified profile does not clear the locksmith ad restriction.
facts.quote: Advanced verification is separate from Google Business Profile verification. A verified profile does not clear the ad restriction.

facts.fact: Enlightened Media, a Google Ads agency for locksmiths, cites a $40 house lockout job and a $300 smart key job competing for the same budget when they share one campaign.
facts.quote: shows a $40 job and a $300 job competing for the same budget when they share one campaign.

facts.fact: Adwave lets advertisers target a radius, a ZIP code set, or a city or national audience.
facts.quote: Adwave lets you target a radius, a ZIP code set, or a city or national audience.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative locksmith campaign example, the TV spot is 15 seconds long.
facts.quote: A 15-second TV spot shows the company van pulling up and a uniformed technician at a front door

facts.fact: The page's illustrative campaign example describes a residential locksmith with two vans.
facts.quote: A two-van residential locksmith builds its offer around trust.

facts.fact: According to the page, pausing an Adwave campaign stops future daily charges.
facts.quote: Pausing stops future daily charges.

facts.fact: According to the page, a new daily budget on a live Adwave campaign applies the same day if the wallet covers it.
facts.quote: A new daily budget on a live campaign applies the same day if the wallet covers it.

facts.fact: Adwave reports assisted conversions alongside last-touch credit, according to the page.
facts.quote: Adwave reports assisted conversions alongside last-touch credit
